scope.audit_spine: every row of the verified crsp_signal_date_universe table
scope.calendar_filter_rule: Read the verified calendar as date metadata only and immediately restrict every downstream relation to dates not after 2014-12-01. Predictor outputs may not exceed 2014-10-31.

physical_store.feature_columns: all 163 economic features in frozen registry order
physical_store.lineage_files: one long Parquet shard per frozen feature family
physical_store.lineage_missing_value_rule: When a feature value is missing, all three lineage date fields are null and value_status records the stable reason. Partial attempted inputs never create lineage dates.
physical_store.lineage_present_value_rule: For a present derived value, observation and public-availability dates are the maxima across every contributor actually used. stale_after_date is the minimum applicable expiry across active current anchors only; historical component/comparison rows exempted by an explicit bundle rule do not shorten it.
physical_store.unknown_category_lineage: An explicit UNKNOWN categorical or multihot value is retained in the raw store, while lineage dates are null and value_status records the first applicable missing cause. UNKNOWN is not mislabeled PRESENT.
physical_store.no_event_lineage: NO_EVENT is PRESENT only after positive source/link coverage is established; lineage observation and public-availability dates equal the dated coverage observation used at the signal.

crsp_price_returns.join: exact permno and consecutive global sessions; DlyRetx transitions form the adjusted path and literal closes provide the positive-completeness gate

crsp_market_and_scoring_cross_section.join: rolling market history to long-eligible signal cross-section

crsp_returns_or_market.join: exact permno and calendar_date for the formula-selected input

crsp_identity.join: historical permno daily rows satisfying frozen regular-way predicates

compustat_and_crsp_market.join: signal key to ccm_gvkey, timely bundle, and same-signal market cap

compustat.join: signal key to ccm_gvkey and timely bundle

sec_13f_and_crsp_shares.join: selected filing to holdings, normalized CUSIP8 to report-date identity, and report-date shares

sec_filings.join: signal key to matched sec_cik and trailing availability window

restatements.join: notification key to matched permno and signal trailing window

compustat_segments.join: signal key to ccm_gvkey and timely segment snapshot

sec_8k_items.join: signal key to matched sec_cik and trailing availability window

crsp_identity_and_compustat.join: signal identity and contemporaneous CRSP SIC plus selected timely fundamental bundle

optionmetrics_flow.join: matched date-valid secid plus exact session windows

optionmetrics_flow_and_crsp_market.join: matched date-valid secid flow and exact permno underlying-volume sessions

optionmetrics_historical_volatility.join: matched date-valid secid, exact signal date, exact vendor horizon

monthly_factors.join: consecutive factor months publicly available by signal

pastor_stambaugh.join: latest recursively eligible monthly observation publicly available by signal

row_filter_and_keys.duplicate_key_rule: fatal; no arbitrary tie-breaking or latest-record overwrite
row_filter_and_keys.quarterly_sequence: fyearq*4+(fqtr-1) must advance by exactly one and all current-bundle rows must share one fyr
row_filter_and_keys.prior_year_quarter: same gvkey, permno and fqtr with fyearq exactly one lower
row_filter_and_keys.prior_year_annual: same gvkey and permno with fyear exactly one lower

quarterly_bundle.selection: latest four consecutive fiscal quarters whose observation date and public availability date are not after signal; only the latest quarter anchoring the current bundle must also satisfy signal_date<=stale_after_date
quarterly_bundle.consecutive_rule: quarter sequence must advance without a gap across fiscal-year boundaries
quarterly_bundle.annual_fallback_trigger: fewer than four consecutive timely quarterly rows; field-level missingness never triggers a basis switch
quarterly_bundle.prior_year_flow_bundle: the four consecutive quarters ending four fiscal quarters before the current bundle endpoint; otherwise prior-year flow is missing
quarterly_bundle.prior_year_balance: the balance four fiscal quarters before the current endpoint; otherwise prior-year balance is missing
quarterly_bundle.average_balance: arithmetic mean of the current endpoint balance and the balance four fiscal quarters earlier
quarterly_bundle.currency_rule: all four current rows must share one nonblank currency for accounting-to-accounting ratios; accounting-to-market ratios additionally require USD
quarterly_bundle.staleness_rule: stale_after_date is enforced on the latest quarter that anchors the selected current bundle; older component, beginning-balance, and prior-year rows must have been publicly available by signal but are not independently rejected for becoming stale after their historical role

annual_bundle.selection: latest timely annual row when the quarterly-bundle trigger fails
annual_bundle.prior_year: latest timely row for the immediately preceding fiscal year
annual_bundle.average_balance: arithmetic mean of current and immediately preceding fiscal-year balances
annual_bundle.staleness_rule: stale_after_date is enforced on the latest annual row that anchors the selected current bundle; the prior-year comparison row must have been publicly available by signal but is not independently rejected for becoming stale

fundamentals.share_growth_resolution: Missing for TTM rows because the verified quarterly source has no quarterly shares field; computed only under ANNUAL_FALLBACK from current and prior-year csho. CRSP shares may not be substituted.

crsp_market_and_return_rules.price_path_input: normalized adjusted price-return path from verified raw_return_ex_distributions (CRSP DlyRetx): oldest level equals 1 and each later level multiplies the prior level by 1 plus that session's price return; the N literal closes remain positive completeness gates but never determine a path level
crsp_market_and_return_rules.price_path_completeness: every transition after the oldest path level must be an observed ordinary_one_session row with mapped_trading_periods=covered_trading_sessions=1, an exact immediately preceding global-session span, return_history_usable=true, outcome availability by signal close, finite DlyRetx greater than -1, and no duplicate, gap, overlap, multi-session, delisting, suppressed, imputed, or unresolved leg; all N literal closes must be positive
crsp_market_and_return_rules.price_path_corporate_action_rule: CRSP DlyRetx measures price appreciation without ordinary dividends and applies the price adjustments needed for splits and qualifying distributions, so mechanical split price changes do not create false path jumps while genuine price gains and losses remain
crsp_market_and_return_rules.fixed_window_completeness: Except for beta_label, every requested global-session window requires every formula-specific input for every session. Partial-window scaling is prohibited.
crsp_market_and_return_rules.return_leg_window: authoritative return legs must cover the exact requested global sessions once without gap or overlap, and every used leg must have outcome_availability_date not after signal
crsp_market_and_return_rules.volatility_change_clock: current 63-session estimate divided by the median of the 252 immediately preceding daily trading-session 63-session estimates, excluding the current session; all 252 prior estimates must be valid

beta_label_numerics.input: one-session authoritative_total_return minus same-session rf, with FF5 plus UMD and an intercept
beta_label_numerics.solver: numpy.linalg.lstsq on the square-root-weighted float64 design
beta_label_numerics.rank_deficient_or_nonfinite: all six slopes and idiosyncratic volatility missing
beta_label_numerics.clip_rule: type-7 1st and 99th percentiles separately by signal and factor
beta_label_numerics.clip_application: apply the long-eligible bounds to every audit-spine slope; non-long rows never influence the bounds
beta_label_numerics.idiosyncratic_volatility: computed from the unclipped fitted intercept and slopes
beta_label_numerics.lineage: max return calendar/outcome-availability date and max factor observation/public-availability date across used rows

statistical_edge_rules.nonfinite_storage: null; NaN and infinity are prohibited in published Parquet values

spread_hierarchy.scoring_population: long_eligible rows at each signal date
spread_hierarchy.security_quote_method: median full quoted spread when at least 10 of 20 global sessions pass bid>0, ask>=bid, and full spread<=0.20
spread_hierarchy.security_corwin_schultz_method: when the quote method fails, median of at least 10 valid overnight-adjusted overlapping Corwin-Schultz pairs in the same 20-session window
spread_hierarchy.cell_assignment: Within primary exchange and among long-eligible rows with a finite positive assignment value, sort independently by (market_cap_usd,permno) and (median_dollar_volume_20d,permno). For zero-based rank r among N rows, bin=floor(5*r/N)+1. Missing/nonpositive assignment values receive no bin and no peer imputation.
spread_hierarchy.fallback_statistic: ordinary median of available security-level quote-or-Corwin-Schultz spreads
spread_hierarchy.non_scoring_row_rule: A non-long-eligible audit row may retain a valid security-level quote/Corwin-Schultz estimate but does not receive a peer-cell imputation.
spread_hierarchy.corwin_schultz_pair_validity: prior close and both adjusted daily highs/lows are positive, each adjusted high is not below its adjusted low, all logarithms are finite, and the resulting full spread is finite after flooring a negative estimate at zero
spread_hierarchy.cell_minimum_definition: at least 20 scoring securities contributing a present security-level quote-or-Corwin-Schultz spread

ownership_13f.identity_link: normalized CUSIP8 to exactly one CRSP identity interval valid on report_date; unmatched or ambiguous lines are excluded and audited
ownership_13f.filing_selection: for each manager_cik and report_date, use the latest filing available by signal_date; an available amendment replaces the earlier filing
ownership_13f.security_aggregation: exclude nonblank put_call rows; aggregate duplicate equity lines by manager, report_date, and linked permno
ownership_13f.current_snapshot: for each manager, choose that manager's latest nonstale report_date available by signal after amendment folding; aggregate these manager-latest positions even when managers' report dates differ
ownership_13f.staleness: each selected filing must satisfy signal_date<=stale_after_date
ownership_13f.ownership_ratio: sum across current managers of manager reported shares divided by CRSP shares outstanding on that manager's report_date
ownership_13f.breadth: log1p of managers with positive reported shares
ownership_13f.hhi: sum of squared manager shares divided by squared total positive manager shares
ownership_13f.change_1q: comparable-manager change: for each manager with both a selected current filing and an immediately preceding distinct report_date filing available by signal, compute current ownership fraction minus prior ownership fraction and sum across the target security's comparison universe
ownership_13f.change_1q_comparison_universe: for each target permno, use the union of comparable managers with positive linked equity shares in either their selected current filing or their immediately preceding filing; a security omitted from either existing filing is an authoritative zero position, so full exits and initiations are retained
ownership_13f.change_1q_manager_without_prior_filing: exclude the manager from the comparable-manager change and count it in QA as noncomparable; do not encode its unknown prior position as zero and do not make otherwise comparable managers missing
ownership_13f.change_1q_no_comparable_security_manager: missing when the target security has no manager with both current and prior filings and a positive position at either endpoint
ownership_13f.pre_source_coverage: missing before the first 13F public_availability_date in the verified source
ownership_13f.snapshot_staleness_anchor: stale_after_date of each manager's selected current filing; earlier report-date observations used only for the change calculation need only have been available by signal

sec_and_restatements.sec_positive_coverage: auxiliary signal linkage sec_match_status equals MATCHED
sec_and_restatements.unmatched_or_ambiguous_values: missing, except categorical features use their explicit UNKNOWN state
sec_and_restatements.qualifying_financial_results_6k: unavailable in the verified data; generic 6-K is prohibited from this classification, so interim-financial features use 10-Q only
sec_and_restatements.eight_k_item_normalization: Unicode NFKC, trim outer whitespace, uppercase; blank remains missing
sec_and_restatements.eight_k_multihot_order: UNKNOWN, NO_EVENT, then distinct normalized development values in UTF-8 byte order
sec_and_restatements.restatement_positive_coverage: a nonblank normalized date-valid CRSP CUSIP8 exists at signal and the signal is not before the first verified restatement public-availability date
sec_and_restatements.segment_resolution: all four segment features are missing because the verified segment table contains zero rows

identity_categories.normalization: Unicode NFKC, trim outer whitespace, uppercase; blank maps to the feature-specific unknown category
identity_categories.sic_normalization: accept one through four ASCII digits, left-pad to four digits, and use the first two digits for sic2
identity_categories.domicile_fallback: CRSP Y maps to USA, N maps to UNKNOWN_FOREIGN, otherwise UNKNOWN_COUNTRY
identity_categories.valid_country_code: exactly three ASCII letters after normalization
identity_categories.foreign_indicator: known USA maps to 0; a known non-USA country or CRSP N fallback maps to 1; unresolved maps to missing
identity_categories.category_order: explicit registry order when supplied; otherwise explicit unknown first and normalized development values in UTF-8 byte order
identity_categories.dynamic_vocabulary_population: long_eligible development scoring rows only; non-long audit rows never add categories
identity_categories.encoded_column_name: feature_name + '__category__' + slug + '__' + first eight hex characters of SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 category
identity_categories.slug_algorithm: Unicode NFKD; drop combining marks and non-ASCII code points; lowercase; replace each maximal run outside [a-z0-9] with one underscore; trim underscores; use literal 'category' when empty

optionmetrics.matched_rule: auxiliary signal linkage optionmetrics_match_status equals MATCHED with one date-valid secid
optionmetrics.complete_flow_session: both authoritative CALL and PUT rows exist for the secid and session; TOTAL rows are always excluded
optionmetrics.window_rule: every global session in a requested flow window must be complete
optionmetrics.zero_rule: zero is valid only from dated CALL and PUT rows whose genuine-zero fields support the relevant value; noncoverage is missing
optionmetrics.signal_open_interest: CALL plus PUT open interest on the signal date
optionmetrics.lag_rule: use the same feature for the same permno at the exact prior rebalance signal one or three calendar months earlier; both endpoints must be present
optionmetrics.coverage_indicator: one only when dated complete CALL-and-PUT coverage exists at signal; unmatched or ambiguous is missing
optionmetrics.coverage_age: completed calendar months since first complete CALL-and-PUT session not before the current link interval start; a changed secid/link interval resets age
optionmetrics.historical_volatility: exact secid, signal date, and frozen vendor day code; no nearest-date or nearest-horizon substitution

aggregate_state_numerics.monthly_factor_completeness: all requested consecutive completed factor months through the signal month must be present and publicly available by signal
aggregate_state_numerics.market_volatility_input: daily MKT-RF, not total market return
aggregate_state_numerics.pastor_stambaugh_level: latest level publicly available by signal; never carry beyond the verified series end
aggregate_state_numerics.pastor_stambaugh_pairs: consecutive observed monthly levels only; a calendar-month gap breaks a pair
aggregate_state_numerics.pastor_stambaugh_fit_endpoint: last AR(1) pair ends one observation month before the innovation month
aggregate_state_numerics.pastor_stambaugh_solver: float64 OLS with intercept via numpy.linalg.lstsq using rcond=1e-12

listing_age.eligible_history_row: security_type EQTY, security_subtype COM, share_type NS or AD, conditional_type RW, trading_status A, and primary exchange N, A, or Q
listing_age.first_date: earliest such historically observed CRSP daily row at or before signal

quality.outliers: report finite min, type-7 p01, median, type-7 p99, max, and nonfinite count; do not cap raw economic values

feature_outliers.parquet.rows: numeric features times observed signal years

publication_payloads.timestamp_rule: timestamps are audit metadata and are excluded from content-addressed build and verification IDs
publication_payloads.build_id_rule: phase03-features- plus first 24 hex characters of SHA-256 over canonical JSON containing policy/rules/registry/FF12/code hashes and authenticated input receipts
publication_payloads.verification_id_rule: verify- plus first 16 hex characters of SHA-256 over canonical JSON containing build ID, primary manifest hash, verifier code hash, reconstructed checks, differences hash, and output hashes
